newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Philip Morris in pole position for Tabaqueira.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris in pole position for Tabaqueira.

text.p: U.S. concern Philip Morris, in alliance with the Jorge de Mello group, was ranked first by a special jury evaluating bids to buy Portuguese state tobacco company Tabaqueira, sources close to the privatisation said on Friday.
The jury's report was delivered to the Finance Ministry earlier this week.
The report, which will serve as a basis for the final cabinet decision on the winner, placed French company Seita second ahead of Spanish tobacco company Tabacalera, the sources said.
Philip Morris offered 5,100 escudos por share for the 6.5 million shares, equal to a 65 percent stake, that the government is selling.
Tabacalera, which is allied to Madeira company Empresa Madeirense de Tabacos offered 5,610 escudos, while Seita bid 4,800 escudos.
But besides price, the jury also took into account the industrial plans that each candidate presented for Tabaqueira.
